landing.title: Pinned
landing.tagline: One link. One game. Hosted by an AI you invent.
landing.body: Describe a host in one line, drop the link in your group chat, and play a photo game in the gaps of your day. Nothing to install.
landing.step1: The host sets a photo challenge — “Find the most suspicious object on your desk.”
landing.step2: Everyone submits privately whenever they get a minute. The host judges and teases.
landing.step3: Cut-outs are revealed, you guess whose is whose, and the host makes the poster.
landing.soon: The demo is coming next; creating a game is live now.
create.title: Create your host
create.intro: Describe the host in one line. Pinned turns that line into a persona, a challenge, and a link for your group chat. No account needed.
create.briefHelp: Examples: a dramatic sports commentator, my unimpressed grandmother, a noir detective.
create.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
create.resultIntro: Share the player link in your group chat. Keep the admin link private — it is the only creator credential in link-only mode.
game.rubricFit: Fit — Does it answer the challenge?
game.rubricChaos: Chaos — How delightfully unhinged is it?
game.rubricNote: Each category is scored from 0 to 5. The highest total wins; earlier submissions win ties.
game.next: Photo joining and submissions are the next build step. Keep this link — it is the game.
admin.title: Creator controls
admin.invalid: This admin link is invalid or incomplete. Open the full private link from game creation.
admin.ready: Admin link verified. Force-close and deadline controls arrive with the reveal build step.
join.title: Join this game
join.intro: Pick the name your group will see at reveal. No account needed.
join.name: Display name
join.roast: How hard may the host roast your photo?
join.poster: Include my entry in the final poster and share card
join.pinHelp: Use the same name and PIN to recover this identity on another device.
join.error: Could not join. Please check your details and try again.
join.readyBody: Photo submission is the next step. Keep this game link; this device now remembers you.
join.closed: This game is no longer accepting new players.
